objective: Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

description: <name>, I'm finally ready for real samples of dragon eggs!  Here, take this collectronic module.  It's designed to extract a dragon egg and prepare it for transport.  Go back to the Rookery and use the module to collect eggs.
And don't forget to freeze them first, or they might hatch before you can collect them!
When you have enough eggs, bring them to me!
progress: Do you have the eggs, <name>?  My patron heard you were collecting them for me, and is very eager to get his hands on them!
completion: Wow, you got them! The collectronic module worked! I'm a genius!
Thank you, <name>. My patron will be very pleased to get these eggs...
